headline: Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse Lead Contested Frontline Clashes
war_summary: Combat intensity shifted sharply toward Linn of Mercy over the past two hours, where six rapid base exchanges occurred around Outwich Ranch. Weathered Expanse remained bitterly contested, logging two additional transitions right up to the morning wire while sustaining over eleven hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour window. Peripheral friction also continued along Stlican Shelf, where two base flips were reported near Breaker Town, and at Pari Peak, which recorded another contested exchange. Conversely, base turnover slowed to a halt across Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand during the latest two hours, though Kuura Strand continues to absorb mounting troop casualties. Heavy attritional fighting without base alterations remains entrenched in Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle, Farranac Coast, and Olavi's Wake, where casualty rates surged across accelerating engagements.
